note: Closed lists for record tags. The validator rejects any tag value not listed here, so search, filters and age modes never meet a surprise value. Add a value here (with a note) before using it.
regionNote: Continental regions after UN M49, plus Antarctica as a region (not a country). Sub-regions can be added later as tags.subregions.
statusNote: draft -> checking -> (changes-requested -> draft) -> reviewed -> approved (Emmanuel) -> published. withdrawn = removed for a safety/rights/correction reason; archived = retired. A record's status alone never publishes it: the build channel decides which statuses ship (content/src/build.json).
